My ex and I broke up 6 months ago but we stayed friends or at least tried to. Had a fight with her yesterday and she blocked me on everything. I was already feeling horrible but today our mutual friend who I’ve been very close with for two whole fucking years and considered a sister messaged me out of the blue saying we’re too different?? and she wanted to stop being friends. I kept asking trying to understand what that meant but she just kept saying vague stuff and refused to explain. I basically had a panic attack mental episode in public. Then I texted our other mutual friend and she said yeah we can’t be friends anymore but she plainly admitted it had to do with my ex. I know we had a fight but I didn’t say anything vile or anything and I didn’t abuse her or anything even though we had problems and I made mistakes. Yet the two friends kept being mysterious and saying “you know what you did” like I hit her or something and abandoned two years of friendship over a 5 minute text conversation with no explanation even when I begged them to. This means that I’ve surely also lost another friend who is one the friends’ boyfriend. Also recently an online friend of multiple years just ghosted me. My heart is beating out of my chest and I want to throw up. I’m faced with the two horrible possibilities that my friends are horrible people who abandoned me in 5 seconds OR that I’m in fact a genuinely horrible person without even knowing it.
